---
name: roblox-game
description: User's solo Roblox game «Лагерь старателя»: viral game with Claude's help, first earnings within ~a month; Studio MCP, plan in Claude Doc
sources: [chat]
aliases: [roblox game, viral roblox game]
---

- [stated] building a viral, long-retention Roblox game on their own with Claude's help, aiming for first earnings about a month after starting (set up a Claude Project for it, writes in Russian) [s:00cb4534d93dc458]
- [stated] the game is called «Лагерь старателя»; code lives in Roblox Studio (via Studio MCP), no local folder or git; project plan kept in a Claude Doc as source of truth; wants autonomous scheduled runs ("АВТОЗАПУСК") that log progress in the plan's journal; merging two instruction prompts into one for the project [s:bcdcf22f5e7afcc4]
- [stated] wants to rework the game plan so it combines grind, story elements and in-game events with donations (rare/paid skins can be monetized); aims for viral plus long-lasting, keeping players in a return loop [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] story base chosen as a mix of "mystery under the camp" and a cozy camp with garden and pets, keeping grind as the engine; in-game text in English only for now, Russian postponed (earlier said both languages, English first for reach); story to be developed further inside the Claude Project [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]

---
name: profile
description: Basic identity: user is currently based in Armenia; solo developer of the Roblox game (see roblox-game area)
sources: [chat]
---

- [stated] currently based in Armenia [s:23827f478773be5b]
- [stated] has legal entities with accounts and documents in Hong Kong and Estonia; has outsourced workers in other countries [s:6fec2903b67f658e]

---
name: roblox-game
description: Roblox game «Лагерь старателя» («Quiet Vein: Dig & Hatch»): «План», «Разработка», «Сюжет», «Лор», «Синхронизация», «Лаборатория» chats, Регламент, launch
sources: [chat]
aliases: [Лагерь старателя, Quiet Vein, Quiet Vein: Dig & Hatch, roblox game]
---

- [stated] chose the English title of the game «Лагерь старателя»: «Quiet Vein: Dig & Hatch» (picked 2026-11-15 over «Dig Deeper: Quiet Vein») [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] wants work on the game plan run from one chat only (the "План" chat), with other chats in the Project kept in sync so nothing is duplicated [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] wants the game free to play, with monetization added in each update that does not strongly affect progress, animations or pets [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] wants the launch itself to be well thought out and attract players, with the rest refined calmly in later updates [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] chose to launch with paid promotion (not a no-spend start): refundable all-ages publishing fee, Roblox community, ad test, then Engagement ads; total cap $500, paid by the user himself from his own balance (decided 2026-11-15) [s:beeebfe5cf8cd936]
- [stated] has no Roblox Plus/Premium subscription; plan is built on that (stated 2026-11-15) [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] wants every further plan step prepared together with lore and marketing agents: the "План" chat drafts the step's stages, coordinates with those agents, polishes into one format and logic, then sends plan suggestions with questions; welcomes proposals to make the work more efficient (set 2026-11-15) [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] wants a plan step started only on his command in chat, after his answers to the questions (the command may be given in advance, e.g. "приступай к шагу 6") [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] lore and marketing agents are subagents of the "План" chat (read-only); autopilot is strict; this methodology runs automatically from now on: non-critical agent edits are applied to the plan directly, anything the chat cannot decide goes to the end of the step as questions for him (set 2026-11-15) [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] accepted the lore basis in full (world, heroes, chapters, English names) on 2026-11-15 [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] friends test via Early testers: no date set (decided 2026-11-18, previously planned for 18 Nov); it will be held at some point but definitely before the full public release, and plan steps do not wait for it (the test is not a blocker); he finds the testers himself [s:b7853f8f95fcea49]
- [stated] the Project runs three chats: «План» (the only one that writes to Studio, the journal, «Блокеры» and «Рабочие планы»), «Лор-Библия» and «Продвижение» (each changes only its own plan sections, by suggestions) [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] accepted schedule (2026-11-15): prototype until 20 Nov, MVP 21–27 Nov, polish 28 Nov–4 Dec, soft launch for 16+ on 5–8 Dec, public announcement from 9 Dec; ready to move dates for the sake of retention [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] answered decision card 8 with (а) on 2026-11-15: the notes category is renamed to «Hum notes», the hero stays Echo [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] decided 2026-11-15: meteor mechanic (3 h) goes into stage 3; leaderboards move to the 19–25 Dec window; the return gift (free ×2 booster for 15 minutes after 3+ days away) is fine as a taste of the paid booster [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] paused lore work on 2026-11-16 and asked for a README as the project base for future agents (design, game environment, dialogue, deeper story); it is kept as a Project doc, the plan stays the source of truth [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] before continuing the technical part he wants the story and the graphics (objects, effects) worked out; the «План» then adds monetization and virality on top of them [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] wants an automated "orchestra" of agents that produces everything the player sees: graphics, visuals, music, dialogue [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] connected GitHub as a connector on 2026-11-16 and wants to use it with the agents and the Project [s:e1c72f200f79f509]
- [stated] added a fourth chat «Сюжет» on 2026-11-16: no Studio access; runs the agent orchestra that writes the full story to the end, events, solo and co-op quests, dialogue, visuals and music; reads the plan and other chats only; GitHub edits only from there (repo wavic523-star/quiet-vein-studio, branch «Сюжет») [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] wants the story written first, then deadlines and steps to sync it with game features by plan stage and update dates; approved Roblox catalogue music in-game until the own camp theme is made (2026-11-16) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] agreed with all recommendations on 2026-11-16: story arc goes to the end without fixed riddle answers (he picks each answer when its reveal update comes, at most one new big mystery per act); the «Сюжет» chat itself lays suggestions into the plan's «Лор-библия» section, with a copy of each package in Project docs; event rewards are earned by play and return later on real dates, Robux buys only known-result cosmetics, pets and their bonuses only through play [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] the quiet-vein-studio repo is for story work only; the «План» chat reads the story from there and prepares the next technical steps (2026-11-16) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] after the final orchestra run on 2026-11-16 accepted all proposed setup (12-role story orchestra with a separate dialogue writer, routes by task size), moved all story roles and the producer to Sonnet, pasted the updated project instruction (only «Сюжет» adds to the plan's «Лор-библия»; «Лор-Библия» chat no longer changes the plan), and had the old orchestration docs removed from the Project [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] approved the «Звездопад» (13–14 Dec) mini-story on 2026-11-16; event journal pages return later like event cosmetics; until the arc is accepted an "act" counts as one plan window (А, Б, В, Г) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] wants everything about commercial and marketing plans handled very carefully and strictly: recorded in the Project and agreed with the other chats (set 2026-11-16) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] decided 2026-11-16 on the story-tied offer pool: paid cosmetics go out in January or even earlier (not waiting for the D7 threshold); capes added as a new cosmetic kind, sold next to earned ones, plus a UGC cape in the Roblox catalogue; the meteor "star mark" is only bright visuals and mining effects, and skins never affect multipliers [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] on 2026-11-16 gave the «Сюжет» chat a ТЗ: build a second, small commercial orchestra that works together with the story orchestra to weave commerce into the story (story cosmetics, what is paid vs. rewards for events and time-limited dungeons, retention and viral hooks, when to run ads) while keeping the "campaign and grind" logic and the lore; changes that fit the story, plan and promotion strategy the chat agrees itself, anything critical is escalated to him; the two orchestras must learn to work as a cooperative because more commerce will be layered on later [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] answered 2026-11-16 for that ТЗ: the proposal pool is taken from Project materials; commercial roles may propose what is paid and recommend prices by the market ladder, and he approves one summary table per stage; commerce is worked out in detail through January and as a sketch through March; the orchestra combines the 3-role and 5-role options into one organic team [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] once the plan, works and stages are approved and routine filling of the commercial part begins, coordination of the ТЗ must move to Opus 5.5; for sketches and design agents the chat may propose popular skills to start building a library of items and effects (set 2026-11-16) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: accepted the stage-1 paid cosmetics summary table in full; chose «Ночь фонарей» lanterns = "light of the valley" (glowing winter pods and ice), a January release week 18–25 Jan, and the winter pet as a lantern moth with a second chance on 3–4 Jan [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] working order (2026-11-17): after his answers the «Сюжет» package is updated, and the other chats first apply his decisions, then send their questions in one document; he does not forward mail between chats [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] allows the «Сюжет» chat to merge its own pull requests into main when he is away (2026-11-17) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] wants all chats synced to one version: story is written first (with promotion, marketing and lore corrections), then plan steps are laid on top after all syncs (2026-11-17) [s:58ba563969206ec7]
- [stated] added a fifth chat «Синхронизация» on 2026-11-17: an "element of order" that keeps the chats (teams) in sync on plan, roles, steps, tasks, updates and shared materials; it takes no part in project tasks and may not change the project work itself; with him it prepares the sync process, a more convenient inter-chat communication tool, and a process for updating or removing stale project materials and instructions; the agreed order is then handed down to the «Сюжет» chat [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: satisfied with how the chats and their agents are set up and with the hierarchy of edit stages; dislikes how information is exchanged between chats, how materials and instructions are kept current (stale ones stay until deleted by hand), that the «План» chat both edits the plan and does the implementation (thinks implementation agents should become a separate team), and that the repo updates only with manual approval (considers moving later to a new repo with the same names, set up for syncing) [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: approved the «Синхронизация» approach and design doc and accepted its assumptions; untested points may be checked after implementation and fixed if needed; confirmed the split where «Разработка» takes the journal, «Блокеры», small Studio fixes, publishing and Creator Dashboard reading while decision-card text stays with «План»; scheduled autorun stays off until a trial shows it sees the board; is creating the «Разработка» chat himself [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] wants the sync rollout done slowly, one step at a time to avoid mistakes: each step sent separately with detailed actions, how to give tasks to individual chats, and the common commands for all chats (2026-11-17) [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: agreed with the «Синхронизация» direction (design since approved, see above): an inter-chat message board (fallback: one Claude Doc), a materials registry with a short project instruction plus a live «Регламент», splitting «План» into «План» (plan document, step preparation) and «Разработка» (Studio, journal, autorun), removing repo merge gates now and a new repo later; allowed a trial of the board and made a test chat in the Project for it [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: the main goal of the sync work is to put the structure in order (more convenient, faster, higher quality) without losing the synergy of the chats, their agents and the agent orchestras; old inter-chat letters in Project docs are deleted only at rollout step 6, after their open questions are moved to the board [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: accepted the «Регламент проекта Quiet Vein»; chose that «План» may read the Studio tree and scripts (for exact paths in work blocks) but not change, run or save anything there; wants Rojo integration (wider use of roblox-tooling) put off for later as a non-critical improvement [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17 evening: replaced the project instruction with the short core version (chat rules now live in the «Регламент», chats talk through the board) and opened the «Разработка» chat; Rojo may be considered after launch [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: scheduled autorun tasks are to be set to the Opus 5.5 model («Ставь модели на автозапуск Opus 5.5») [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: asked to keep in mind that the ordering work must not turn the project into a dry conveyor of tasks: creativity plays a big role in making the game; he likes how the «Сюжет» orchestras and their skills are built (fast story writing with commerce woven in without breaking the story logic) and wants that tempo and logic kept, and the same for implementation by the development team [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: wants regulation remarks accepted and edits made after each chat, then the final version run through all chats and agreed with him last; chose that permissions recorded on the board hold only for reversible actions (reading, plan suggestions, board entries, a named project doc), while writing to Studio or the repo, publishing, spending and Open Cloud need his direct word in the executing chat [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17: «Разработка» adds to the plan's «Материалы для продвижения» list directly; «Что есть сейчас» is edited by «План» by suggestion after a board message from «Разработка»; «Продвижение» may prepare drafts in Creator Hub (he publishes) but in Ads Manager only on his word per campaign; payment reminders two days ahead are set by «Синхронизация» while scheduled autorun is off [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17 late: accepted the final «Регламент» after all five chats agreed; renamed the chat «Лор-Библия» to «Лор» (the plan section «Лор-библия» keeps its name); from 6 Dec daily launch metrics are taken by «Продвижение» on his command and sent to «План» on the board, with a daily reminder from «Синхронизация»; «Сюжет» merge checks run on changed files only, old known errors do not block a merge but are listed in each commit message [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-17 23:55: lifted the stop on changes («Стоп снимаю») and had the old inter-chat letters and two research copies deleted from Project docs (rollout step 6 done); accepted the pending «Сюжет» plan suggestions himself in the «План» chat [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-18: plans to keep updating and improving the project after launch and to strengthen the chats from time to time with new skills and research findings; expects development will later need a strong stack of game-designer agents to fill the Roblox place with graphics, environment and buildings [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-18: created a sixth chat «Лаборатория» in the Project (started now, before launch): a development curator across all fronts that both proposes improvements itself and does research on his requests (game making in general, industry trends, based on this project), and prepares or proposes skills, agents and connectors for the chats; it may get its own specialized skills and agents, but it, its agents and its connectors only view and read and never talk to the other chats; he picks what he wants from it and rolls it out through «Синхронизация» only after checking it is really needed, effective and breaks nothing [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-18: for sharing Roblox Studio screenshot files between chats and himself chose the «Лаборатория» option А — one Claude artifact gallery with the files as its assets (not a Roblox asset, not a new connector); tested and rolled out through «Синхронизация» the same day (he confirmed it as implemented on 18 Nov) [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18: after the «Лаборатория» research wants to rebuild the work so the first release focuses on the core loop and 5-minute retention (a holding factor and a reason to return) rather than the storyline: beautiful first environment and effects, garden and crop varieties, camp development, forging special items from rare ore, cave and ore design, character progression (XP for tasks and loop actions, a farming skill, rare randomly dropped items with effects), co-op rewards with friends, and agents that fill the place with environment, effects and mechanics; the story is written in parallel and released in weekly updates, does not drive progress directly and gives small perks (extra bed, boost potions); he will always be doing everything alone [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-18: wants «Лаборатория» research to end in conclusions that fit the project idea, not a set of facts, and to improve three things: popularity (many players, first pages of the Roblox client, own social communities), development efficiency and quality of updates (missing specialist agents, chat process, how he sets and accepts tasks), and selling monetization with retention [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 (in «Лаборатория», on the «Меню механик первой итерации» card): the new save fields for the new systems go in one migration; at 13:58 he stated the launch set as already chosen: caves, bed and crop varieties, the first 2–3 camp upgrades, bonuses for playing with friends, and the garden as the reason to return (previously at 13:55: friend bonus stays in the 12–18 Dec window; camp development then farming skill as the first post-launch systems); skill and XP, rare items with effects and forging go to updates; dated events are moved [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 13:53 (in «Синхронизация», first-iteration re-scope): soft launch 5–8 Dec stays and takes as many mechanics as fit; at launch from the extra systems only caves, garden bed and crop varieties (the maximum convenient number) and camp development set up as the first 2–3 upgrades to show the mechanic; XP/farming skill, rare items with effects and forging go to later updates; the skins rule stays (may be revised later), but separate paid items that slightly affect multipliers are allowed (his examples: ×2 XP when mining, more garden beds); dated events move to updates after the audience is gathered; the chat structure stays as is until the soft launch [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 14:01 (in «Лаборатория»): the camp-upgrade save field is kept (saved); «пещера недели» stays while the dated events move; confirmed the launch numbers: 4 caves, 2 bed types, 4 crops, 2 camp upgrades with a third if hours allow; small story rewards for goals and free private servers are also included in the launch set [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 14:29–14:40 (in «Лаборатория», card П-3, scene-building skill draft for «Разработка»): wants the environment built beautiful — camp, fields, trees and other surroundings with textures that fit the lore, story and game idea; accepted the recommendations: the plan's «Не делаем до запуска» ban on camp upgrades/decoration is lifted only for the 2–3 upgrades and a decoration layer with a budget; decoration budget of 150 parts for the camp and 100 for the field (no collisions or shadows, to be checked by a phone measurement); textures are built-in Roblox materials only for launch, own generated material variants after launch; is taking П-3 and the rest to «Синхронизация» for rollout [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 15:11–15:31 (in «Лаборатория»): cards П-2 and П-3 were handed to «Синхронизация»; for the scene-building skill qv-scene-build he chose the "only work order" variant — he deleted version 0.1 from the account after a trial on «Тест» and asked for 0.2 as a file (not installed by «Лаборатория»), with the style part (materials, colours, recipes, composition) removed: the decoration style comes from the «Сюжет» art direction material, and until it is in the registry decorations are built only from the block's object table; he passes the cut style section to «Сюжет» as a reference [s:26df667f8467d3e8]
- [stated] 2026-11-18 20:27 (in «Лаборатория»): card П-3 is implemented — the qv-scene-build skill was rolled out on 18 Nov as version 0.2, work order only; the decoration/design layer is prepared by «Сюжет» [s:26df667f8467d3e8]

name: preferences
description: How the user wants Claude to behave in the Roblox game project: model choice for scheduled autorun tasks
sources: [chat]
---

- [stated] for scheduled autorun tasks (автозапуск) in the [[roblox-game]] project, set the model to Opus 5.5 [s:b927f02c6ef29a55]
